levels.surface: أبو الحسن علي بن محمد حباب

notes: four routes, each opened by a «و قال» and each ending at Aqid the servant; the «كلهم حكوا عن عقيد الخادم» sentence closes the Khayruwayh and Washsha routes together, and it is written inline in each route since no single tail covers all four
the saying «وُلِدَ وَلِيُّ اللَّهِ» is Aqid's report, so he is the last link in each route
the Imam is not named in the chain, and nothing is inherited: the report is read as it stands
